name: Fae
source:
The story starts as our brave heroine Lin is sent out on a dangerous quest to deliver a bottle of ginseng tincture to Grandfather Shi living on a faraway (about two hours ride) mountain.
It's a sort-of-Chinese fairy tale.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25962]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
故事开始于我们勇敢的女主人公林被派去执行一项危险的任务，为住在遥远的山上（大约两个小时车程）的石爷爷送一瓶人参酊剂。
这是一个有点中国式的童话故事。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25962]引理软论坛[/url]]
